fact: The ANSD Situation économique et sociale du Sénégal, edition 2024, made public on 24 February 2026, publishes government revenue statistics for 2024 (tax revenue 3,833.0 billion FCFA, taxes on international trade 498.4 billion FCFA from import duties); the article names no record-holder beyond the ANSD.
title: Recettes fiscales : 3 833,0 milliards de FCFA collectées en 2024
